quest.title: To Turn Each Sin Against the Sinner
quest.description: Something seems amiss in Dreadshade Mire...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x350, Primogem x40, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x4

dialogues.text: The light's on... Master...? Is that you?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, there's someone in that house...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: After a brief moment, a young Ratnik emerges from the house.
*sigh* I—I thought it was my master returning. Turns out it's just a couple of passersby...
Wait a minute... This place is dangerous. The swamp is crawling with Wild Hunt and other monsters. I have no idea how you even made it this far, but... Hmm, the Wild Hunt outside...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Don't worry, we already took care of them!
W—What!?
*sigh* If I'd known such strong adventurers would be passing by, I'd never have allowed my master to go off alone...
That great fool — he said, "Haha! It's only right that the stronger Lightkeeper faces the most enemies! I'll deal with that rabble, then I'll come back for you!"
...He lured most of the monsters away... He even left his lantern behind...

dialogues.speaker: Oskari
dialogues.text: Anyway, thank you for helping take care of the Wild Hunt. My name is Oskari — I'm a Ratnik.

dialogues.speaker: Oskari
dialogues.text: Master and I came here for a routine patrol of the swamp, but... the moment we arrived, something went wrong with the sealing pillars. That's when I saw it...

dialogues.speaker: Oskari
dialogues.text: It was a huge silhouette, looming in the mist, darker than a starless night... and behind it... waves of twisted monsters, crawling...

dialogues.speaker: Oskari
dialogues.text: It could only have been the Serpent of All Evils... I didn't think the rumors of it being sealed here were true...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's just calm down for a second...

dialogues.speaker: Oskari
dialogues.text: Ah... Ahem... Sorry. A Lightkeeper shouldn't lose their composure. It's just... Thinking about it sets my nerves on edge...

dialogues.speaker: Oskari
dialogues.text: This won't do... Pull yourself together, Oskari... It's time you started acting like a true Lightkeeper...

dialogues.speaker: Oskari
dialogues.text: Alright... The seal may be weakened, and this place is incredibly dangerous, however...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Don't sweat it, we're happy to help!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But what exactly is this "Serpent of All Evils"? Some kind of monster that escaped?

dialogues.speaker: Oskari
dialogues.text: ...The Serpent of All Evils was said to be a high-ranking official back in the days of the Belyi Tsar — he was also close friends with that Rotwang character...

dialogues.speaker: Oskari
dialogues.text: He was rumored to be ruthless, eliminating Rotwang's enemies at all costs... In the end, he fell along with Rotwang and transformed into a monster of pure darkness...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sounds like a slippery, snakey scoundrel who deserves to be tied into a big sturdy knot!

dialogues.speaker: Oskari
dialogues.text: Couldn't have said it better myself! He was the sort of person who would cling to life even if it meant biting through his own flesh. If someone like that really turned into a monster... I don't even dare imagine...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, in that case, we'd better find a way to re-establish the seal and stop him from breaking free again.

dialogues.speaker: Oskari
dialogues.text: Wonderful! ...Though I don't actually know quite how to do that. If only my master were here...

dialogues.speaker: Oskari
dialogues.text: He jokes around and likes to act tough, but... sometimes he can be kind of reliable.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "Sometimes" he can be "kind of" reliable? How can you only be sometimes reliable!?

dialogues.speaker: Oskari
dialogues.text: Well, I guess it's more like... When the stakes are high, he's always reliable. So maybe this time... he might actually...

dialogues.speaker: Oskari
dialogues.text: N—Never mind. Let's just focus on finding a way to reseal the Serpent of All Evils...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Don't worry about that — you just leave the sealing to us! After all, your Master told you to stay put, right?

dialogues.speaker: Oskari
dialogues.text: Well, if you're willing to help. It's just... are you sure it's alright? Ugh... If only I weren't so useless! Please... the sealing... I'm counting on you!
Heehee... Jelly... are you licking my face again? Your tongue's so soft... Yes, yes, you're the sweetest little kitty in the whole wide world...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait... Why does he look so out of it...? Hey! Get a grip, will you? There's no "Jelly" here!
Huh? Where'd Jelly go...? Did someone scare her away?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, snap out of it! There was never a cat here to begin with!
Oh... That's a shame... Looks like I'll have to keep going a little longer in this Jelly-less world...
I have some medicine in my pocket... If you could... help me...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Of course. Leave it to us! You stay still and save your strength!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: After taking the medicine from the injured Ratnik's pocket and quickly tending to his wounds, he starts to look a little better.
You two really know how to treat a wound... I honestly thought I was about to see little Jelly again. Not that I would have been sad to see her...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey! Your cat can wait! Staying alive is the only thing you should be focusing on right now!
You're right... Thanks for your help. It's just... Jelly left me over ten years ago now. I really... really miss that soft little ball of fluff...

dialogues.speaker: Janusz
dialogues.text: Honestly, thank you for saving me. My name's Janusz, by the way, and you?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Paimon's Paimon, and {M#he}{F#she}'s {NICKNAME}! Janusz, can you walk? If you can, we'll escort you out of here!

dialogues.speaker: Janusz
dialogues.text: ...It's a tempting offer, but I'm afraid I have to decline. I know I can never repay you for saving my life, but I'd still like to ask that you first travel to Piramida and request reinforcements...

dialogues.speaker: Janusz
dialogues.text: I... I need to stay here and continue my investigation.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Even with such a serious wound?

dialogues.speaker: Janusz
dialogues.text: Honestly, I'll be fine. Don't worry about me.

dialogues.speaker: Janusz
dialogues.text: The seal on the swamp has already weakened — someone must keep watch over it. Besides... that fool apprentice is probably still waiting for me. Leaving a comrade behind just isn't the Lightkeeper way.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? The seal on the swamp? What's that?

dialogues.speaker: Janusz
dialogues.text: There's said to be a sinner sealed in this swamp — a vile individual who once made a pact with a demon and was turned into a monster...

dialogues.speaker: Janusz
dialogues.text: He must've done some really despicable things, because five hundred years ago, he was sealed here by the combined efforts of the Torchforger and the Moonchanter of the Frostmoon Scions.

dialogues.speaker: Janusz
dialogues.text: Anyway, that's all an outsider needs to know. Please, deliver my request. It's still dangerous around here, so you'd better get moving.

dialogues.speaker: Janusz
dialogues.text: I just need a little more time to catch my breath. I still have tasks I need to attend to.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But Janusz... Your condition...

choices.text: If it's about fixing the seal, maybe we can help?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! Breaking seals, fixing seals — we're all about that seal life!

response.speaker: Janusz
response.text: ...Really? For some reason, I get the feeling you're not making that up...

response.speaker: Janusz
response.text: Hmm... The situation here might be far more dangerous than you imagine. Even so...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Even so...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Just one question — can we really re-establish this seal? Didn't it take the Torchforger and the Moonchanter working together to create it in the first place?

response.speaker: Janusz
response.text: The seal itself doesn't require any special power. The Torchforger and the Moonchanter left their strength behind in the three stone sealing pillars...

response.speaker: Janusz
response.text: There are a total of <color=#00E1FFFF>three pillars in this area — if you can channel kuuvahki into the location of each pillar</color>, the ancient seal will be restored.

response.speaker: Janusz
response.text: And the <color=#00E1FFFF>Spireblooms that grow there can inflict some serious wounds on the monster</color>... at least, that's what the handbook says.

response.speaker: Janusz
response.text: If you really manage to seal that thing again, I don't know how I'll ever repay you... How about this — in my next life, Jelly and I will come back as house cats for you?

response.speaker: Janusz
response.text: We'll keep our fluffiest patches of fur just for you so you can pet us all you want!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Seriously? How can you make jokes at a time like this!?

response.speaker: Janusz
response.text: Hehe, it's important to maintain a sense of humor no matter what the situation... Ahem. Anyway, let's get a move on!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #No way! You can barely stand! You take it easy and let Paimon and {NICKNAME} deal with the sealing!

response.speaker: Janusz
response.text: *sigh* You're not wrong. If I went along in this state, I'd only get in your way. I hate to admit it, but... I'll leave the seal to you.

response.speaker: Janusz
response.text: Still, I am feeling better since you treated my wound. Even if I can't fight, I can still make myself useful in other ways. Besides... I still don't know how that fool of an apprentice is doing...

response.speaker: Janusz
response.text: I'll head off to find him right away. If everything goes well, we'll figure out a way to help you from there. For now, you two be careful!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Don't worry! We'll have this all tied up in no time!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: After a few more sincere exhortations to "stay safe," Janusz sets off. His silhouette is almost instantly swallowed by the mist...

choices.text: There's no way we're leaving you here.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Right... If we head to Piramida now to get reinforcements, it's going to take ages. And by the time they arrive... you and Oskari, well...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ugh! We can't just leave you here! And besides, we're pretty experienced when it comes to sealing away monsters!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Among the shadows scattered by the wind, a final whisper faded like ripples on a pond.\n"Why... Rotwang... why..."
Stop getting in my way, Oskari! I can still fight! If we keep dawdling like this, we won't be able to help!
I—It's over... That thing... It's really...
Finally... we don't have to fear that shadow in the mist any longer... The gloom that's hung over this place for five hundred years has been lifted...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Janusz, you're here! Good news, we've already taken care of the monsters!
*sigh* One step behind. The moment I heard the commotion, I rushed straight on over... Oh well, as long as everything ended well, that's all that matters.
Th—That's such a relief!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait a second! Janusz, are you not still injured?
I had a little rest after meeting up with Oskari. I'm feeling alright now — there's no need to worry.
But Master... You can't stay here — your wounds need to be properly cleaned and bandaged to prevent infection!
What's the rush? Didn't I tell you? Impatience is a rookie mistake.
But Master, you also told me, "Acting tough is a fool's mistake!"

choices.text: It seems like a fool's mistake is worse...

response.text: #Hey! You're taking his side? Come on, {NICKNAME}, we've still got too much left to do!
We need to check the seal, investigate the area for anything unusual — we can't leave yet. Besides, you're seriously underestimating me, I'm Janusz, the— ow, ow, ow!
Master...
All right, all right! Let's wrap this up quickly. Oh! Before I forget, thank you — without your help, we might never have been able to take care of that monster in the swamp!
And I want to thank you too — for saving my master!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, one big bad guy down, and two honest compliments earned. Paimon couldn't ask for a better outcome!

choices.text: The only hand that can fell a master... is his own.

dialogues.text: I'll stay here and wait for my master to return. If there's anything you want to know, I'll do my best to answer your questions.

choices.text: About the Serpent of All Evils...

response.text: Huh? Are you asking about when that monster was still human? That was over five hundred years ago.
Back then, under the Belyi Tsar, most of Snezhnaya's power was still in the hands of the fae nobility. He was one of the few humans to make it into politics.
Things went downhill the moment he became a disciple of Professor Rotwang.
Under Rotwang's influence, he used coercion, entrapment, even murder to sideline his master's political opponents.
Rotwang's rise to power would have been impossible without him. Seeing what he's now become, maybe it's simple retribution for all that he did.

choices.text: About the monster in the swamp...

response.text: You want to know how someone from five centuries ago could turn into a monster like that and then end up in this swamp? I've spent no small time investigating those very questions — but I've never found a definitive answer.
My guess is that he came here after Rotwang fell from power... But as to how he was sealed away... none of the texts I've searched record such details.
The seal has remained stable for the last five hundred years. Even so, we Lightkeepers still check on it regularly — just in case.
I didn't think this patrol would be any different from the others... Master...
*sigh* I just hope he's safe.
I should be the one saying that to you! The deeper parts of this swamp are even more dangerous. I truly hope you don't run into trouble...

dialogues.text: *sigh* I feel like I've been no use whatsoever...
Really? According to who? You followed my instructions and stayed out of harm's way instead of rushing in and making things worse. That in itself is commendable.
If you can't remain unbiased and objective, I'm not sure I can trust you to write the report for this incident.
Y—Yes, Master, you're right... Wait— hold on. Did you just say... You're trusting me to write the report!?
R—Really!? I—I won't disappoint you!
Good. Keep it clear and concise. Just explain the cause, the outcome, and everything in between.
Hmm... I think I might have an idea about the cause of the seal weakening! We passed by a Fatui camp just now — I wouldn't be at all surprised if they were somehow involved!
How very perceptive... We'll go back and investigate later. Once we've gathered sufficient evidence, we can file an official protest with the Fatui.
Heehee... Jelly... are you licking my face again? Your tongue's so soft... Yes, yes, you're the sweetest little kitty in the whole wide world...

Huh? Where'd Jelly go...? Did someone scare her away?

Oh... That's a shame... Looks like I'll have to keep going a little longer in this Jelly-less world...
I have some medicine in my pocket... If you could... help me...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We ran into him a while ago, somewhere over that way. He was hurt, but we took care of his wounds. He should be on his way to find you soon.
Thank goodness he's okay... I was starting to think I might be making more than just cat food for Jelly at the next... well... anniversary.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
